text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One night, on the training track—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, quota met.
Time for a break...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, City-san.
Are ya trainin' this late again?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Oh, Yukino.
Yeah, figured I would.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I got totally crushed in that mock race during class the other day.
Felt like I had to step it up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, workin' so hard just for that...
I gotta follow your example~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No no, there's nothing to follow!
I lost, remember?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard you work,
it doesn't mean a thing until results follow, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? But still,
you workin' so hard makes you someone I truly look up to, City-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Cause results or not,
you're always so wonderful when you run...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, was I bein' a busybody country bumpkin just now?
S-Sorry 'bout that~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—No. Thanks, Yukino.
That actually cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright, guess I'll push myself for one more round!
